verdict.rationale: Brex Travel is a first-party travel product offering 'global inventory and auto-enforced expense policies on one platform.' Booking objects carry a `policy` field showing whether a booking was out of policy and which travel rules it violated, so policy is evaluated on the booking itself. A user praising 'Brex Travel' confirms the product is real, but the evidence never names flights and hotels or says whether out-of-policy bookings are blocked or only flagged. missing for 10: explicit documentation that flights and hotels are bookable in-platform, evidence that policy blocks or requires approval at booking time rather than only flagging violations, independent hands-on corroboration of booking-time policy enforcement.

support.subject: As an employee, I can book flights and hotels in-platform with travel policy applied at booking time, not expensed and argued about later

citations.quote: Simplify travel with global inventory and auto-enforced expense policies on one platform.
Added `policy` to booking objects, exposing whether a booking was out of policy and which travel policy rules it violated.
Lists trips according to the filters passed in the query string.
